Wondrous Item, Legendary

This heavy tome is bound in dragonhide and reinforced with thick bands of cold iron. The original copies were made by the wyrmspeakers of the Cult of the Dragon and bear the cult’s symbol on their cover. The Tome of the Dragon holds the secret ritual that turns a dragon, or a dead dragon’s body, into a dracolich.

To decipher and use the tome, you must be a spellcaster with at least two level 5 spell slots, or a Dragon. A single assistant (or more, at the DM’s discretion) can help you perform the ritual, as long as that assistant also meets the requirements to use the tome.

To create a dracolich with the tome, you need constant access to the body of an adult or ancient dragon, living or dead, and 80,000 GP worth of supplies (including a gem that will anchor the dracolich’s spirit). With those materials, you must perform a ritual lasting 180 days divided by the number of creatures performing it. During the ritual, you and your assistants must work without interruption, resting no more than 8 hours per day. If you are a Dragon, the cost of the supplies and the ritual’s duration are halved.

When the ritual is complete, the tome bursts with violet light, dealing 12d6 Necrotic damage to you and each assistant. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage dies and immediately rises as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmZombie00000000]{Zombie} under the DM’s control.

At the end of the ritual, the target becomes a dracolich. If it was a living dragon, it dies at once, and its spirit passes into the gem supplied for the ritual. If it was a dead dragon’s body, the body reanimates, and an evil dragon spirit from the Outer Planes takes up residence in the gem. The dracolich owes nothing to its creators and acts according to its nature.

Foundry Note

Le profil de dracoliche n’existe pas dans dnd5e. Violet Burst inflige les 12d6 Necrotic à la fin du rituel.
